scope: Bounded offline candidate scan, not an exhaustive semantic audit or proof that no suitable natural case exists anywhere. Indexed all 1042 H.6 claims; read all 18 operation passages with supplied target/source instruments, then reviewed nominated claim scopes and nearby context. Read all 24 H6.R1 selection claims. Screened all 30 older E operation passages against their supplied source operations. No historical warrant/role/evaluation judgments were used for selection.

missing_observation: Negative supplied operation with intact SATISFIED fidelity and an already inspectable OPERATION_LICENSE violation.
admission_consequence: Without the negative contrast, the known route that can retain an operationally invalid supplied action remains untested. No scientific resolution or permission to return is established.
minimum_intervention: A clean existing natural negative component with positive supply evidence and intact qualifications; if none can be furnished, a later narrow synthetic substitute requires explicit user authorization. No further evaluator machinery is justified by this selection stop.
